GAK route also returns permission_required=true for unapproved actions
GAK evaluates_policy blocks protected paths before permission request

B1_TOOL01_GAK_PATH_VERIFICATION.conclusion: TOOL-01 and GAK are separate but parallel authority paths. Both enforce permission gates and workspace path safety. No confirmed bypass of all governance layers. However, the split between TOOL-01 pattern routing and GAK natural-language routing creates duplicate authority and potential policy inconsistency.
B1_TOOL01_GAK_PATH_VERIFICATION.recommended_next_action: Consolidate TOOL-01 permission logic into GAK evaluate_action_policy to ensure single policy engine governs all tool executions, or add explicit GAK gate before _tool01_router execution.
